Read the case notes below and complete the writing task which follows.
 Notes:
 You are a GP. Ms Maria Sorocco has been following up with you.


 Patient: Maria Sorocco

 D.O.B. 15/08/1943
 Social history: widow and lives with her daughter

Past medical history:
2014 htn- commenced beta blockers
2015 surgery skin cancer leg (3 lesions) treated with skin graft
2015 venous ulcer Rt leg


 17/05/2019
Recurrence of Rt leg ulcer
Treated with analgesia, conservative treatment

25/02/2019
Ulcer healing with no swelling or redness

4/6/2019
Mild swelling and redness
Began to go shopping almost daily

15/6/2019
Increased redness and swelling
Ulcer: purulent exudate, antibiotic described
Dressing: daughter not sure to reapply dressing
 
Plan:
Arrange for visits by district nurse 1 day first week then 1-2/week for the second
week
Arrange for wound swab
Arrange for Doppler ultrasound

Review after 2 weeks
 Writing task
 Using the information in the case notes, write a letter of referral to Mrs.
 Gloves to arrange for visits. Address the letter to
 Mrs Gloves, District Nurse, 10 Stillwater St, Newtown.
